$comment: Brand data for hyperai-tui. The build (scripts/build-patch.mjs) reads these values to produce the pnpm patch that rebrands the upstream @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui package; the logo art is generated from the canonical SVG source brand/hyperai-logo.svg by scripts/generate-logo-art.mjs.

logo.origin: Official HyperAI logo SVG provided by the user: /Users/zhenhaoli/Downloads/logo-icon-border-1.svg (white circle + embedded 271x267 rose icon, 120x120 viewBox)
logo.format: SVG, 120x120 viewBox, 8-bit RGBA embedded icon (271x267 PNG data URI)
logo.treatment: Generated into two whale-format letter-grid sprites (40x40 main, 26x26 compact) and a 512x512 transparent RGBA PNG, all from the canonical SVG, by scripts/generate-logo-art.mjs: the SVG is composited analytically (white circle + embedded icon through its pattern mapping, 4x4 supersampling), alpha-cropped, downsampled/quantized along the SVG's own white->rose blend line. The PNG is embedded in the generated module for the terminal image protocol path (upstream Image component); the sprites are rendered by the whale's renderSpriteRows. No redraw, no recolor, transparent pixels stay transparent. Light-theme variants repaint only the circle's existing outer edge with the SVG's own icon accent as a thin rim (the official white plate is invisible on a pure-white terminal background); dark themes keep the official rendering.
